title: Hue and Phong Nha in 4 days
summary: The Hue Citadel and Minh Mang, a night in Dong Hoi, then Phong Nha Cave and Paradise Cave. Son Doong is its own expedition.

days.title: Day 1 — Hue Citadel
days.body: Visit the Hue Citadel and eat bun bo Hue.

days.title: Day 2 — Minh Mang, then Dong Hoi
days.body: Visit Minh Mang, go on to Dong Hoi, and be at Nhật Lệ for sunset. The rail posts are 166 km apart, and that figure is the railway.

days.title: Day 3 — Phong Nha Cave
days.body: Boat into Phong Nha Cave. The visit is about 2.5 hours. It is about 50 km from Dong Hoi, called southeast, or about 50 km with the direction left unnamed.

days.title: Day 4 — Paradise Cave
days.body: Walk the boardwalk in Paradise Cave, then return toward Hue. Son Doong is its own expedition, not this day.

seoTitle: 4 days in Hue and Phong Nha
seoDescription: Hue, Dong Hoi, the Phong Nha boat cave, and Paradise Cave in four days.
